name: cleanroom
description: Remove leftover third-party code and rewrite affected modules through an isolated clean-room process, with similarity scans, human risk gates and a hash-chained audit trail.

install_jplag.title: Add-on: JPlag similarity checker
install_jplag.description: Download JPlag and a portable Java 25 runtime (about 150 MB) into the plugin's data folder. Verify needs a second, independent similarity check; without this add-on you must point config 'jplag_jar' and 'java' at your own copies.

install_scancode.title: Add-on: ScanCode Toolkit license scanner
install_scancode.description: Install ScanCode Toolkit (about 130 MB) into its own virtualenv in the plugin's data folder. The final license scan needs it; without this add-on you must set config 'scancode' to your own install.

scancode_source.title: ScanCode offline source (optional)
scancode_source.description: A ScanCode Toolkit source .zip, wheel (.whl) or folder you already downloaded. If set, the add-on installs from it instead of downloading from PyPI.

builder_auth.title: Builder credential
builder_auth.description: subscription: the builder container uses your Claude Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise plan through a separate token from `claude setup-token` (set CLEANROOM_BUILDER_OAUTH_TOKEN). api_key: it uses an Anthropic API key (set CLEANROOM_BUILDER_API_KEY).

analyzer_model.title: Analyzer model
analyzer_model.description: Model for the analyzer (reads upstream, writes specs). Must differ from the builder model.

builder_model.title: Builder / test-writer model
builder_model.description: Model used inside the isolated container. Must differ from the analyzer model.
